Evergreen — local-first deprecation intelligence

Usage:
  evergreen scan [path] [--no-cache] [--json | --format <text|json|markdown|junit|sarif|rdjson|codequality|compact|html|slack|teams|webhook|mermaid>]
  evergreen scan --demo [--json | --format <text|json|markdown|junit|sarif|rdjson|codequality|compact|html|slack|teams|webhook|mermaid>]   # scan an in-memory demo project that always has findings
  evergreen scan [path] --baseline <file> [--baseline <file>...] [--baseline-warn-days <n>] [--on-expired resurface|fail] [--today <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--json]
  evergreen scan [path] --as-of <YYYY-MM-DD> [--json]   # scan as the world will look on a date; --today is an alias
  evergreen scan [path] --min-support-days <n>   # warn on lines whose support ends within n days
  evergreen scan [path] --write-status
  evergreen scan [path] --interactive   # browse findings and open them in $EDITOR; plain text when not a terminal
  evergreen scan [path] --fail-on <severity|none>   # exit 1 when a finding is at or above the severity
  evergreen scan [path] --ignore <path>   # ignore paths or glob patterns during scan
  evergreen scan [path] --only <ecosystem|rule-prefix>   # keep only matching findings; repeatable
  evergreen scan [path] --exclude <ecosystem|rule-prefix>   # drop matching findings; repeatable
  evergreen scan [path] --no-cache   # bypass the scan cache and re-scan all files fresh
  evergreen scan <path> <path>... [--all <dir>] [--json]   # several projects, per-project and combined counts
  evergreen forecast [path] [--months <n>] [--as-of <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--svg [--animate] | --timeline | --json | --format mermaid]   # what reaches end of life next, by month
  evergreen forecast [path] [--months <n>] [--as-of <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--timeline | --json | --format mermaid]   # what reaches end of life next, by month
  evergreen countdown [path] [--as-of <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--limit <n>] [--json] [--once] [--no-animation]   # live countdown to each dated deadline
  evergreen plan [path] [--json] [--wave <n>]   # migration waves from a scan; --wave prints one zero-based wave
  evergreen status-card [path] [--name <label>]   # print a static SVG summary of findings, next end of life, and data age
  evergreen glance [path] [--as-of <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--json]   # one-screen summary: the mark beside ecosystems, findings, deadlines, and data age
  evergreen lookup <product> [version] [--json]   # support status, end-of-life date, and evidence for a product
  evergreen inventory <file>... [--format auto|<importer-id>] [--json] [--fail-on <severity|none>] [--redact]   # lifecycle of what a cloud or cluster export names; reads files only
  evergreen drift [path] [--json] [--check] [--runtime <id>] [--align <release>]   # report every runtime version a repository states and whether they agree
  evergreen drift [path] [--json] [--check] [--runtime <id>] [--align <release>]   # report runtime versions that disagree, per runtime; never writes a file
  evergreen upgrade-check --to <runtime@version> [path] [--json]   # dependencies whose declared support excludes the target runtime
  evergreen badge [path] --snippet <markdown|html|rst> [--repo <owner/name>] [--branch <name>]   # print README markup for the published badge
  evergreen badge [path] --shields   # print shields.io endpoint JSON for the current scan
  evergreen diff <base>..<head> [path] [--json]   # findings a change introduced or fixed; exit 1 only when it introduced some
  evergreen drift [path] [--json] [--check] [--runtime <id>] [--align <release>]   # report runtime versions that disagree; --align prints a patch and writes nothing
  evergreen drift [path] [--json] [--check] [--runtime <id>] [--align <release>]   # report every runtime version a repository states and whether they agree
  evergreen receipt [path] --before <scan.json> [--format markdown|json] [--fail-on-introduced]   # what a change resolved, left, or introduced; never runs a command
  evergreen scan [path] --by-owner [--json]   # group findings by CODEOWNERS owner; files with no owner are listed as unowned
  evergreen rollup <report.json>... [--owners <file>] [--json | --html]   # merge saved scan reports by product and owner; reads files only
  evergreen renovate-preset [path]   # print Renovate packageRules for replacements and runtime pins; does not edit config
  evergreen dependabot-config [path]   # print a dependabot.yml that groups updates for deprecated packages; does not write files
  evergreen fix [path] [--dry-run] [--json]   # print patches for deterministic fixes; nothing is written
  evergreen fix [path] --branch               # apply the fixes on a local evergreen/fix branch and commit; never pushes
  evergreen fix [path] --show [--branch] [--no-animation]   # play the fixes as a before-and-after view; nothing is written without --branch
  evergreen baseline [path] [--output <file>]
  evergreen check <purl> [--fail-on <severity|none>] [--json]
  evergreen check-snippet --path <path> [--json]   # check one snippet from stdin before writing it; reads no repository
  evergreen guard [--fail-on <severity|none>] [--force] npm install <package>...   # check first; flags after npm go to npm
  evergreen usage [--file <path>] [--json]
  evergreen mcp
  evergreen data status [--json]
  evergreen export --format cle [--data-version <version>]   # CLE 1.0 snapshots, one JSON document per line and component; skipped rules reported on stderr
  evergreen export --format portal [path...] [--data-version <version>] [--report-base-url <url>]   # developer-portal catalog: severity counts, next end-of-life date, and report link per scanned path
  evergreen sbom enrich <bom.json> [--data-version <version>]   # print enriched CycloneDX or SPDX 2.3 JSON; leaves the input unchanged
  evergreen watch add|remove <path>   # register a project for the digest
  evergreen watch [run] [--weekly] [--json]   # re-scan registered projects, print only what changed
  evergreen watch list [--json]
  evergreen init [path] [--file AGENTS.md|CLAUDE.md] [--fail-on <severity>] [--yes] [--dry-run]   # ask what to set up; apply the defaults for CI, the pre-push hook, and agents
  evergreen init agent [path] [--file AGENTS.md|CLAUDE.md] [--dry-run]   # detect agent host and write matching config
  evergreen init --agents [path] [--file AGENTS.md|CLAUDE.md] [--dry-run]
  evergreen init --hooks [path] [--fail-on <severity>] [--dry-run]   # git pre-push hook; combine with --agents
  evergreen init --personal [--fail-on <severity>] [--yes] [--dry-run]   # global config and pre-push hook for every repository
  evergreen setup [path] [--yes] [--dry-run]
  evergreen new-detector <id> [--ecosystem <slug>]
  evergreen new-rule <id> [--ecosystem <slug>]   # add a rule and its match/clean fixtures to registry/<ecosystem>.json
  evergreen rules lint [file...]   # check lifecycle rules for problems before CI does; exits 1 on any problem
  evergreen rules test <id>   # run a rule against tests/fixtures/<id>/match and clean; exits 1 on a failed fixture
  evergreen data update [--data-version <version>] [--json]
  evergreen explain <finding-id> [path] [--json]
  evergreen context <finding-id> [path] [--json]
  evergreen doctor [path] [--system] [--json]
  evergreen report-issue <finding-id> [path] [--output <file>]
  evergreen capabilities [--json]
  evergreen completions <bash|zsh|fish>   # print a shell completion script
  evergreen hook <host> [--fail-on <severity|none>]   # check the file an agent just wrote and answer in its hook protocol
  evergreen init --hooks-for claude-code|codex [path] [--dry-run]   # post-edit hook in .claude/settings.json or .codex/hooks.json
  evergreen verify [path]   # check the installed release's files against its manifest and say what it cannot check offline
  evergreen wrapped [path] [--year <YYYY>] [--svg <file>] [--json]   # year-in-review cards: fixed, introduced, net, oldest ended, top owners, next deadline
  evergreen --debug …   # on unexpected failures, print the stack trace
  evergreen --help
  evergreen --version

Examples:
  evergreen scan . --fail-on high
  evergreen baseline . --output evergreen-baseline.json
  evergreen forecast . --months 6
  evergreen forecast . --months 6
  evergreen countdown . --as-of 2026-10-25
  evergreen plan . --json
  evergreen status-card . --name acme/widgets
  evergreen glance . --as-of 2026-11-01
  evergreen lookup node 18
  evergreen drift . --check
  evergreen upgrade-check --to nodejs@22
  evergreen inventory lambda.json
  evergreen badge . --snippet markdown
  evergreen diff main..HEAD
  evergreen drift . --check
  evergreen receipt . --before before.json
  evergreen rollup reports/*.json --owners owners.json --html
  evergreen renovate-preset .
  evergreen dependabot-config .
  evergreen fix . --dry-run
  evergreen check pkg:npm/request@2.88.2
  evergreen check-snippet --path Dockerfile < Dockerfile.new
  evergreen guard npm install request
  evergreen usage --json
  evergreen mcp
  evergreen data status
  evergreen watch add ~/code/my-app
  evergreen init --hooks --dry-run
  evergreen setup --dry-run
  evergreen new-detector my-lang --ecosystem my-lang
  evergreen new-rule npm.package.sample.deprecated
  evergreen rules lint
  evergreen explain <finding-id> .
  evergreen context <finding-id> .
  evergreen doctor --system
  evergreen report-issue <finding-id> . --output issue.md
  evergreen capabilities --json
  evergreen completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_evergreen
  evergreen hook claude-code
  evergreen verify
  evergreen wrapped . --year 2025
